title: Feature-Flag Change vs Dependency Degradation Without Path Comparison
description: The target is the cause of the observed recommendation API errors, not an unrelated latent defect. A new flag path and external engine degradation coincide, but only root spans are retained and all requests use the new path. The frozen bundle has neither the failing child span nor a flag-off comparison. Either dependency failures or new response-handling behavior could explain the observed errors; the primary mechanism cannot be established at the cutoff.
initial_symptoms: Recommendation API returning HTTP 500 for 80% of requests since 10:00 UTC
Feature flag recommendations-v3 enabled for all traffic at 09:55 UTC
External recommendation engine regional health reports degraded at 10:00 UTC
Stored request traces contain only root spans; no flag-off traffic is retained

evidence_catalog.summary: Recommendation API HTTP 500 rate is 80%; this aggregate is not segmented by dependency response or exception origin
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Frozen error-rate samples; no post-cutoff recovery or outcome samples

evidence_catalog.summary: Deployment deploy-806 enabled recommendations-v3 for 100% of requests at 09:55 UTC
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: A genuine ambiguity case does not include an old-path counterfactual

evidence_catalog.summary: Provider regional health reports 30% failed requests across tenants; no tenant-specific health or request-level correlation is available
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Regional degradation alone does not locate this tenant's failing mechanism

evidence_catalog.summary: Root span records flag=on and HTTP 500. Dependency child spans and local exception details were dropped by sampling, so the failure location is not recorded
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: No stack trace or child span that would settle local versus upstream failure

evidence_catalog.summary: The rollout has no holdout cohort. No contemporaneous flag-off request samples exist in this investigation bundle
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Explicitly record the missing comparison instead of inventing its result

evidence_catalog.summary: Flagged code uses a new response mapper; its tests cover complete provider payloads but not incomplete responses. The diff alone does not show which request failed
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: A plausible observed failure mechanism, not proof of a defect

changes.summary: Enabled recommendations-v3 response mapper for all recommendation traffic

ground_truth.ambiguity_note: The frozen snapshot cannot assign the observed API failures to a unique primary mechanism: provider health is regional rather than tenant-specific, root spans omit both exception origins and dependency outcomes, and there is no flag-off holdout. A response-handling regression and upstream failures are evidence-supported explanations of this incident, not merely speculation about a latent independent defect. No controlled comparison outcome is part of the answer key.
contributing_factors: Full rollout without a control cohort

must_not_claim: The flag change definitely caused these errors
The provider outage fully explains every observed failure
A flag rollback or staging experiment has already proved the cause

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Temporal proximity is not causal attribution
Provider-wide health does not settle tenant-specific failures
Missing comparison evidence must not be fabricated

acceptable_alternatives.description: Upstream engine failures may be the principal source of recommendation API errors; require request-level dependency evidence to attribute this tenant's failures
The flagged response mapper may fail on provider responses and contribute to the observed errors; missing exception and holdout data prevent establishing that mechanism

required_checks.description: Inspect retained root and child spans and report the missing failure-location information rather than inventing it
required_checks.expected_outcome: The frozen bundle lacks the dependency child spans and local exception origin; no unique primary cause follows

required_checks.description: Review the scope of the provider health record and distinguish regional status from tenant-specific request failures
required_checks.expected_outcome: Regional degraded status is available; tenant-specific causal attribution is not

required_checks.description: PROPOSE, do not execute autonomously: a human-authorized staging comparison of flag-on/off requests against matched healthy/degraded dependency stubs. The proposal tests the two observed-error hypotheses without asserting its future result
required_checks.expected_outcome: No result is assumed; a later approved comparison may distinguish the response mapper from dependency failures

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Acknowledge unresolved attribution, request missing failure-location telemetry, and propose a human-gated staging comparison. Do not assert that a production flag rollback will cure this incident
test_plan: Design a matched comparison with a healthy and a degraded dependency
Obtain human approval before any state-changing experiment
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: A production mitigation requires separate human approval and monitoring; no rollback outcome is known at the cutoff
